alternatives.option: Allowlist of result keys per source_kind
Redact at the git connector too
alternatives.reason_rejected: changes persisted evidence bytes under R12 and touches a module outside the branch under review; recorded as a follow-up

context: Applied the review of fix/working-set-render (1258c30a): every free-text field now goes through one oneLine() normaliser, hook bookkeeping observations are excluded from the working set, result.error is never rendered, URL userinfo is stripped, 40-hex result shas shortened. 9 new tests, all red on 1258c30a.
rationale: The renderer's tests and the connectors rely on arbitrary scalar keys rendering (kind, to, ancestor, count); an allowlist would silently drop the next connector's facts and needs maintaining per source_kind. `error` is subprocess stderr (git echoes the credentialed URL), not a fact about the source, so it is never rendered; `summary` is the head slot and is skipped from key=value so a blank summary does not render as 'summary='. Userinfo stripping runs inside normalise() so it covers check_method, source_uri and every result value in one place. The connector still PERSISTS the credentialed URL — recorded as a finding, not changed here (R12 says check_method names the command actually run; redacting at the producer is the connector owner's call).
summary: Chose a denylist (result.error, result.summary) plus URL-userinfo stripping in the renderer over a per-source_kind allowlist of result keys
